description: This file defines the MobileService class, which manages mobile app interactions, message handling, dashboard navigation, and user reloading within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: MobileService
classes.description: Service for handling mobile app interactions, dashboard management, and user authentication reloads.

methods.name: isMobileApp
methods.description: Checks if the current environment is a mobile app.

methods.name: handleDashboardStateName
methods.description: Sends dashboard state name to the mobile app.

methods.name: onDashboardLoaded
methods.description: Notifies the mobile app that the dashboard has loaded with layout info.

methods.name: onDashboardRightLayoutChanged
methods.description: Notifies the mobile app of right layout toggle.

methods.name: registerToggleLayoutFunction
methods.description: Registers a function to toggle dashboard layout.

methods.name: handleWidgetMobileAction
methods.description: Handles mobile widget actions, returning observable results.

methods.name: handleMobileNavigation
methods.description: Sends navigation command to the mobile app.

methods.name: onWindowMessage
methods.description: Processes messages received from the window, such as dashboard commands and user reloads.

methods.name: openDashboard
methods.description: Opens a dashboard based on message data, with optional reload.

methods.name: doDashboardNavigation
methods.description: Performs navigation to a specific dashboard URL.

methods.name: reloadUser
methods.description: Reloads user data from JWT tokens.
